title: PYRO-ASTRA Empirical Null Result Finding on Microgravity Combustion Surrogate Generalization
model_nature: Demonstrator on liquid droplets, NOT a habitat safety predictor
label: Defined by the PYRO-ASTRA team
required_finding: On the FLEX droplet data, error rose by 211.3% when the highest-pressure or highest-O2 conditions were held out; the lunar habitat point is outside every measured range and is refused.
executive_summary: Under preregistered grouped leave-one-condition-out (LOCO) cross-validation, 20x repeated grouped validation, and held-out condition extrapolation testing on physical droplet extinction measurements (n = 189, excluding 8 complete-combustion zero rows), statistical surrogate models exhibit severe degradation when generalizing beyond tested clusters. Specifically: On the FLEX droplet data, error rose by 211.3% when the highest-pressure or highest-O2 conditions were held out; the lunar habitat point is outside every measured range and is refused. Linear regression error rose by 211.4% (MAE 0.4320 mm to 1.3450 mm), polynomial regression error rose by 330.1% (MAE 0.4300 mm to 1.8491 mm), and random forest error rose by 51.5% (MAE 0.3622 mm to 0.5487 mm). For operational lunar exploration atmospheres (34% O2, 8.2 psi), no flight test points exist within the parameter convex hull. Pursuant to Rule G6, PYRO-ASTRA publishes this formal Null Result Finding: surrogate models serve strictly as demonstrators on liquid droplets and must never be cited or utilized as spacecraft habitat safety predictors. Life-safety verification must rely exclusively on verified empirical flight records and physical bounding envelopes.

recommendations_for_spaceflight_safety: 1. Label model strictly as a demonstrator on liquid droplets, never a habitat fire safety predictor.
2. Prohibit ungrounded ML surrogate extrapolation to Lunar (34% O2, 8.2 psi) and Martian habitat conditions.
3. Rely exclusively on verified empirical bounding envelopes from 0g and 1g companion tests.
4. Await planned NASA payloads (LUCI and FM2) for authentic partial-g combustion data.
